# `grounded_villages.piece` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

Per-piece rejection (`docs/spec/domains/pieces.md`, GV-7): a pure Java model, no Minecraft, Fabric, NeoForge or Forge import anywhere in this package (`04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-002 -- PieceGate is one of the four pure-logic units named there alongside SiteSelector, TierRoller and ConfigModel).

### `record PieceFootprint(int minX, int maxX, int minZ, int maxZ)` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/piece/PieceFootprint.java`
A candidate piece's own X/Z footprint -- no Y and no Minecraft BoundingBox (`04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-002: this package references no Minecraft type), mirroring grounded_villages.site.SiteCoordinate's own reasoning for the site package.

### `class PieceGate` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/piece/PieceGate.java`
`docs/spec/domains/pieces.md` §3/§5, ticket GV-7 build item 1: evaluates one candidate piece's footprint against `PIECE-REQ-001`-004 -- water in footprint (a flat any-water rejection, not a tunable fraction) and height deviation from the village's own start height (`piece.max_height_deviation`).
- `int WIDE_FOOTPRINT_THRESHOLD` — Footprint axis length (blocks) above which that axis' own edge midpoints are also sampled.
- `PieceVerdict evaluate(HeightSampler sampler, PieceFootprint footprint, int startHeight, int maxHeightDeviation)` — a village's site is evaluated and accepted at"), measured the same way site measures ground height (OCEAN_FLOOR_WG) so the two are directly comparable
- `List<int[]> samplePoints(PieceFootprint footprint)` — Package-visible for PieceGateTest's own sampling-shape assertions.

### `class PieceLadder` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/piece/PieceLadder.java`
`decisions/DEC-010-shrink-move-vanilla.md`'s own shrink/retry decision, kept pure and separate from the "move" (re-run grounded_villages.site.SiteSearch#searchAlternative for a shifted site) and "vanilla" (place unchecked) steps themselves, both of which mean re-invoking vanilla's own jigsaw assembly and so necessarily live in grounded_villages.mixin.village.JigsawStructureMixin instead (`04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-002: this package references no Minecraft type).
- `Outcome evaluate(int rejectedCount, int nonStreetSurvivorCount, int hamletMinimumPieces)` — one assembly attempt

    - **nested** `enum Outcome`

### `class PieceRejectionHook` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/piece/PieceRejectionHook.java`
The live VillagePieceHook a loader entrypoint registers into grounded_villages.hook.HookRegistry#setPieceHook (ticket GV-7 build item 1/3): the first real implementation, now finally called per real child candidate rather than once per parent piece (see grounded_villages.mixin.village.PlacerMixin's own javadoc for the bytecode evidence of where that changed).
- `PieceRejectionHook INSTANCE` — Stateless; one shared instance registered by every loader entrypoint.
- `PieceDecision onChild(PoolElementStructurePiece pieceCandidate, BoundingBox boundingBox, TerrainSampler groundSampler)`

### `enum PieceRejectionReason` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/piece/PieceRejectionReason.java`
Why PieceGate#evaluate rejected a candidate (`domains/pieces.md` §3 "Rejection criteria") -- NONE for an accepted candidate.
